design: support-complete COMPOSITIONAL ring grow/delete (defines the support) + data-derived frequent-ring MACROS (acceleration cache only). The finite catalog must NOT define ring-generation support.
section1_supported_claim: Within the declared state space (broad-organic atom/bond vocab, max_atoms=40, charge-preserving, no stereo/isotope/radical), the operator system supports construction+deletion of any ring topology -- isolated/macrocycle/aromatic/saturated/heterocycle/fused/spiro/bridged/polycyclic -- whenever the successor satisfies executor legality. Topological support completeness is separated from empirical chemically-valid path coverage.

section2_primitives_exist.cycle_close: BondInsert(a,b,order) -- adds a bond between two existing atoms (operators.py:36; rule 'bond_insert' kernel.py:110; is_valid_bond_insert/apply_bond_insert).
section2_primitives_exist.cycle_open: BondDelete(a,b) -- removes a bond (operators.py:43; rule 'bond_delete' kernel.py:111).
section2_primitives_exist.gap: bond_insert/bond_delete exist in the EXECUTOR + general fiber but are NOT in MARK_RULE_NAMES, so the factorized model cannot score/propose them. The redesign wires cycle_close/cycle_open as factorized families (heads + enumeration + supervision).

section3_support_completeness_verified.method: for 400 real broad-organic <=40 molecules with rings: open every non-spanning-tree edge (cycle_open) to a spanning tree, then close every edge back (cycle_close), through the production executor.
section3_support_completeness_verified.verdict: COMPOSITIONAL support-completeness holds at the executor level for all observed ring topologies -- no whole-ring template is required for support.

supervision_implication: The verified open/close decomposition IS the cycle_close/cycle_open teacher signal (every ring bond in the corpus, round-trip verified). So the compositional operators get massive, easy supervision -- unlike the whole-ring template catalog. Multiple valid decompositions per molecule avoid learning one arbitrary ring basis (section-9).

P1_family_design.decision: OVERRIDE the two dead slots cycle_insert(5)/cycle_attach(6) ONLY when enable_cycle_ops, instead of adding new families or ripping the dead machinery. Rationale (all three constraints hold at once): (1) MARK_RULE_NAMES is a GLOBAL constant setting family_head width for every instance -- adding families -> family_head always 12-wide -> not byte-identical + B's 10-wide head shape-mismatches -> whole family head goes fresh (loses B's family-selection training); (2) renaming/ripping the dead slots removes params B's checkpoint carries (cycle_query/cycle_key etc.) -> unexpected-key load failures; (3) the family name must map to an executor rule. So: keep MARK_RULE_NAMES=10 + the dead machinery (byte-identical when off), and when enable_cycle_ops override slot-5 logits/masks/enumeration with cycle_close (BondInsert over closeable pairs, cycle_close_head) and slot-6 with cycle_open (BondDelete over cycle_edge_mask, cycle_open_head), plus a family->executor-rule map (slot5->bond_insert, slot6->bond_delete) keyed on the action type in the sampler, teacher-scoring, and quotient. family_head width unchanged; B's family rows preserved.
